long_biography.plain_text:
Christophe Robin began as a teenage hairdressing apprentice in France and developed a reputation for colour work in Paris. He opened a salon devoted to colour, then launched a line of products for treated hair. The named brand expanded through international beauty retailers, drawing on his salon expertise and a natural-ingredient positioning. In 2019 The Hut Group acquired the haircare business, while his Paris salon remained outside the transaction.

Beyond the salon, Robin developed Ginette hospitality projects, including a private retreat on Mo'orea and a hotel in Saint-Malo. He directs accommodation businesses that operate separately from the original haircare venture. His work in hospitality reflects an interest in creating distinct places and guest experiences; it does not change the origin of the brand fortune. The acquisition's business price cannot establish his personal proceeds or present net worth.
